The collection

ROM hacks

Every build below is a beta English fan translation of a Japan-only release. All downloads are hosted on Catbox — grab the archive, read the included readme, and play. Spot a translation bug? The readme inside each archive lists where to report it.

01 Beta build WonderSwan Color Action RPG 2001

Star Hearts

Star Hearts ~Hoshi to Daichi no Shisha~ · スターハーツ ～星と大地の使者～

A fantasy action RPG from Bandai, released only in Japan for the WonderSwan Color. The continent of Eurus drifts beneath a giant floating fortress, and the story begins as you — boy or girl, with a name, birthday and blood type all of your own — are chosen to become the new chief of Inde Village. Real-time action combat, magic, weapon skills, talismans, fairies and pets fill the world.

  • Full script translated — 9,377 event messages, choices and speaker names
  • Items, magic, skills, talismans, amulets, fairies, pets & art names and descriptions
  • Title screen, new-game flow, menus and world-map plates redrawn in English
  • Name entry opens on an A–Z keyboard; built-in and joke names translated
  • All 479 maps tested in-game — no leftover Japanese text, no empty text boxes

How to install & play
The archive includes a pre-patched ROM — load it straight into Mednafen or RetroArch and play. To patch your own dump of the Japanese cartridge (4,194,304 bytes, CRC32 138D1018), apply StarHearts_EN_v0.9.3.bps with Floating IPS (flips), beat or Rom Patcher JS. Start a new game: saves from the Japanese version are not compatible with the translation.
02 Beta build PlayStation 3D shooter maker 1996

3D Shooting Tkool

3D Shooting Tkool · 3Dシューティングツクール (SLPS-00654)

Not a game but a game maker: ASCII's PlayStation tool for building your own 3D polygonal shooters. Design models from 300+ sample parts, arm your ship with up to three weapons, script enemy movement patterns, assemble stages with backgrounds and BGM — then play what you made. Three complete sample games ship on the disc: ORBITAL FORCE, RIDE ON BROOM and SAMPLE EVENT96.

  • All menus and editors translated — model, ship, motions, stage & config
  • The three sample games fully playable in English
  • Boot sequence, title setup and memory-card screens translated
  • Ships as a ready-to-play patched disc image (.bin/.cue) plus PPF 3.0 patches
  • Intro and menus tested on PCSX-ReARMed, Beetle PSX and DuckStation

Steer with the D-pad: Cross/Square/Circle fire ARMS 2/1/3, R2 boosts, L2 brakes.
03 Beta build Game Boy Advance Sci-fi adventure 2003

Zero One

Zero One · ゼロワン

A story-driven Game Boy Advance adventure in the visual-novel style. You play as Nagomu Joukouji, a high-school student whose father — a robotics professor — has gone missing. What starts as a missing-person case spirals through the summer of 2004 into a conspiracy involving cyborgs, an AI program called Shiro and an organisation called Rude. Branching choices, free-movement scenes and eight mini-games — with 98 bad endings, each carrying its own hint.

  • The whole story, menus, hints, notebook and mini-games in English
  • 8 mini-games: race, memory, fighting, number guess, ball dodge, gauge charge, coin guess & boss battle
  • Notebook (People / Events / Other), recall window and ending list translated
  • Speaker plates, system messages and episode cards translated
  • Test build (cap60) — machine-assisted text, playtester feedback welcome

04 Beta build Game Boy Advance Sci-fi adventure 2004

Zero One SP

Zero One SP · ゼロワンSP (SFアドベンチャー)

The enhanced remake of Zero One, released by Fuuki in 2004 — bigger, stranger and more ambitious. The story splits into four chapters — Cyborg, Noah, Gamer and Conclusion — with new scenarios, new characters (including a new love interest, Tomo Oda), more mini-games and a staggering 175 endings. Murder mystery, sci-fi action, comedy, psychological horror and a love story, all on one cartridge.

  • Episodes E1–E20 rebuilt in English (beta)
  • Branching dialogue, choice menus and scene text translated
  • Character database (Person / Event / Others) translated
  • Four story chapters: Cyborg, Noah, Gamer & Conclusion
  • Machine-translation assisted beta — reports and fixes welcome

05 Beta build WonderSwan Color Card battle 2002

X - Card of Fate

X - Card of Fate · エックス カード オブ フェイト (TV Animation X)

A card-battle strategy game for the WonderSwan Color, based on CLAMP's TV anime X. Kamui Shiro has returned to Tokyo — and the end of the world is near. The Dragons of Heaven, the Seven Seals, defend the barrier around Tokyo; the Dragons of Earth, the Seven Angels, want it destroyed. Command 14 characters and a deck drawn from 256 cards across a story mode, a training simulator and link-cable battles.

  • Full story, endings and map-travel dialogue translated
  • All 256 cards — names, types, effects and detail screens — in English
  • Battle messages, combo names and character quotes translated
  • Title, character-select, Tokyo map and menu graphics redrawn in English
  • Bonus: a hot-seat two-player mode replaces link battles in this build

Getting started

New to ROM hacking? Start here

Three things cover every download on this page: a patcher, an emulator, and your own copy of the original game.

WonderSwan Color & GBA — BPS patches

Most of these hacks are .bps patches. Apply them to a clean dump of the Japanese cartridge with Floating IPS (flips), beat, or Rom Patcher JS in your browser. Every archive also contains a pre-patched ROM, so patching is optional.

PlayStation — ready-to-play disc image

3D Shooting Tkool ships as a patched .bin/.cue — just load the .cue in DuckStation, PCSX-ReARMed or SwanStation and boot. A .ppf patch is included too if you prefer to patch your own disc dump.

Emulators & hardware

WSC: Mednafen / RetroArch (Beetle WonderSwan). GBA: mGBA or a flash cart. PS1: DuckStation, PCSX-ReARMed or SwanStation. All builds were tested on these.

Please note: these are unofficial fan translations, free and non-commercial. They are not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Bandai, Fuuki, ASCII, Success, CLAMP or any other rights holder, and you need your own copy of each original game.
